title: Microsoft Teams: users can report a security concern in meetings
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout facts, licensing, reporting prerequisites and documented controls are supported by Microsoft's sources. Existing tenants' need to enable Defender monitoring is correctly stated, and the remaining documentation gaps are appropriately qualified. The cited Learn pages opened successfully despite the pre-check's fetch errors.
